home.body1: Beautiful, minimal portfolio sites. Built to show the work, not obscure it. Every site different. Every artist served.
home.body2: Discovery without search. A white-label layer that lets customers browse and find what they didn't know they wanted — alongside existing retail infrastructure.
home.body3: Systems built from the user outward. Unconventional, accessible, effective. Users have loved them. IT departments have not.

story.title: Design that happens for a reason
story.subtitle: South of France · Since 2020
story.chapter1: We were in the South of France when we were caught by the lockdown — the confinement. By chance the house next to the one we were renting came up for sale. So we bought it and stayed. We believe things sort of happen for a reason.
story.chapter2: My passion for design, practicability and useability have driven me all my life. I designed systems for lawyers, banks, car leasing, government departments — successfully in the 1990s. The IT departments hated them because they didn't conform. Users loved them.
story.chapter3: Different and better are key to me. I try to keep all functionality accessible — deep menu structures I hate. Minimalist, elegant, effective. Content left, actions right.
